data.name: Kritarth
data.gender_notes: Kritarth is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kritarth is derived from the Sanskrit language and is composed of two words: Krta and Arth. Krta means 'done' and Arth means 'value, worth, or meaning'. This name implies that a person named Kritarth has been judged or criticized, and their worth or meaning has been determined. This name may be given to a child who was born under challenging circumstances or to one who has overcome significant obstacles.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be judged by the universe, to seek inner wisdom and understanding.
data.etymology: Kritarth belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Criticized, Judged.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kritarth total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
